title_en: Guiding Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Providing Judicial Guarantees by People's Courts for Enterprise Mergers and Reorganizations
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Guiding Opinions on Providing Judicial Guarantees for Enterprise Mergers and Restructuring by People's Courts

Fa Fa [2014] No. 7

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Enterprise mergers and restructuring are important means of adjusting and optimizing industrial structure, eliminating outdated production capacity, resolving overcapacity, and improving the quality and efficiency of economic development. They are also effective ways of transforming the mode of economic development and enhancing China's comprehensive economic strength. Currently, China's economy is in a period of growth rate shift and structural adjustment pains, which is also an important period of opportunity for promoting enterprise mergers and restructuring. The 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee deployed various tasks for comprehensively deepening reform. The State Council's "Opinions on Further Optimizing the Market Environment for Enterprise Mergers and Restructuring" (Guo Fa [2014] No. 14, hereinafter referred to as the "Opinions") clarified the main objectives, basic principles, and related measures for promoting enterprise mergers and restructuring. Enterprise mergers and restructuring are important tasks for advancing enterprise reform in the coming period. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the important functional role of judicial adjudication in enterprise mergers and restructuring, and lawfully and orderly promote the smooth progress of enterprise mergers and restructuring.

I. Adhere to Centering on Service to the Overall Situation, Guarantee the Lawful and Orderly Progress of Enterprise Mergers and Restructuring by Rule of Law Means

1. Consciously place judicial adjudication work within the overall work of the Party and the state, and actively respond to the judicial needs of enterprise mergers and restructuring. Enterprise mergers and restructuring are important measures taken by the Party Central Committee and the State Council in the new era to deepen economic system reform, transform the mode of economic development, and adjust and optimize industrial structure. As central and local government departments at all levels gradually implement the tasks of enterprise mergers and restructuring, some disputes will inevitably enter people's courts through litigation procedures. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the complexity of contradictions, breadth of subjects, and magnitude of interests involved in enterprise mergers and restructuring. They must strengthen their awareness of the overall situation and responsibility, closely combine the spirit of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee, and the requirements of the "Opinions," fully leverage the functional role of people's courts in accordance with the law, and effectively ensure the steady advancement of enterprise mergers and restructuring work.

2. Correctly handle the relationship between implementing Party policies and strict law enforcement, achieving the organic unity of legal and social effects of enterprise mergers and restructuring. The major strategic deployments made by the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee are the scientific guide and action program for China's comprehensive deepening of reform at a new historical starting point. Both Party policies and state laws reflect the fundamental will of the people and are essentially consistent. Continuously improving and developing the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and promoting the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity place higher demands on people's courts to correctly implement Party policies and strictly enforce the law. People's courts must profoundly understand, from the height of strengthening national strategy, the great significance of providing judicial guarantees for transforming the mode of economic development and adjusting and optimizing industrial structure. By strictly enforcing the law and adjudicating cases with fairness and efficiency, they achieve the organic unity of legal and social effects in the adjudication of merger and restructuring cases.

3. Attach high importance to enterprise mergers and restructuring work, and lawfully ensure the smooth implementation of enterprise merger and restructuring policies. Enterprise mergers and restructuring not only concern the enterprises themselves but also extensively involve a series of issues such as lawfully and equally protecting the non-public economy, preventing the loss of state-owned assets, maintaining financial security, reemployment and livelihood security of employees, and social stability. People's courts must judge in advance, classify and evaluate, intervene at the appropriate time, and lawfully ensure the orderly progress of enterprise mergers and restructuring work. They must strengthen communication with government departments, and promote the establishment of coordination mechanisms for enterprise mergers and restructuring work as needed, achieving information sharing and smooth procedures. For major or emerging issues discovered during case adjudication and enforcement, they must promptly provide feedback to relevant functional departments or propose judicial suggestions.

4. Lawfully and promptly accept and adjudicate cases related to mergers and restructuring, resolving various disputes in enterprise mergers and restructuring through judicial adjudication. People's courts must lawfully and promptly accept and adjudicate cases arising during the process of enterprise mergers and restructuring, including determination of contract validity, equity transfer, confirmation of investment rights and interests, private financing, protection of financial creditor rights, protection of employee rights and interests, enterprise liquidation, enterprise reorganization, and economic crimes. They shall not refuse to accept cases or delay adjudication without legal grounds.

5. Follow the principle of balancing interests, and lawfully and properly handle various conflicts of interest. Enterprise mergers and restructuring extensively involve the vital interests of various subjects, including the enterprises participating in the merger and restructuring, investors, creditors, and employees. Conflicts of interest and rights during this period are unavoidable. People's courts must, through the legal relationships in individual cases, analyze the essence of interest conflicts, identify the interest subjects and interest claims behind them, and determine the priority order of interest protection in accordance with the law. In cases where laws and regulations do not explicitly provide, common interests should be sought first in conflicts of individual interests, maximizing the interests of all parties as much as possible. In situations where individual interests coexist and conflict with collective interests, social public interests, local interests, and overall interests, individual and local interests should be taken into account while protecting collective interests, social public interests, and overall interests. We must resolutely overcome improper interference from local protectionism, industry and departmental protectionism in judicial adjudication work.

II. Strengthen the Concept of Commercial Adjudication, Fully Leverage the Decisive Role of the Market in Resource Allocation

6. Lawfully determine the validity of merger and restructuring acts, promoting the lawful and orderly circulation of capital. Strictly in accordance with the provisions of Article 52 of the Contract Law on contract validity, correctly determine the validity of various merger and restructuring contracts. Combined with the transaction methods between the parties and market transaction practices, accurately determine the validity and enforceability of preliminary agreements, letters of intent, framework agreements, etc. in mergers and restructuring. Adhere to the commercial adjudication concept of promoting transaction progress and maintaining transaction security, prudently determine the validity of new types of contracts such as enterprise valuation adjustment agreements and share conversion agreements, and avoid simply finding contracts invalid on the grounds of no legal provisions. Respect the autonomy of market entities, uphold the spirit of contract, and appropriately determine the relationship between merger and restructuring transaction acts and government administrative approvals. Properly handle the relationship between company external acts and internal autonomy. Strictly in accordance with the provisions of Article 22 of the Company Law, review the legal validity of resolutions involving company mergers, divisions, issuance of new shares, material asset changes, etc. in mergers and restructuring, from the aspects of meeting convening procedures, voting methods, and resolution content whether they violate laws, administrative regulations, or the company's articles of association. For issues currently without clear legal provisions, such as cross-shareholding voting methods and simplified company mergers, prudently determine the validity of acts based on the facts and results of the case.

7. Establish awareness of equal protection, encourage, support, and guide the non-public economy to actively participate in enterprise mergers and restructuring. The non-public economy is an important component of the socialist market economy. Lawfully ensure that the non-public economy equally uses production factors and openly and fairly participates in market competition. Uniformly apply legal rules, optimize the judicial environment for non-public economy investment, and promote the formation of a fair, competitive, and free market environment. Actively cooperate with the implementation of the negative list management approach for market access, promoting the entry of the non-public economy into industries and fields not prohibited by laws and regulations. Protect enterprises of all ownership types to enjoy equal treatment in investment and financing, taxation, land use, and foreign trade, enhancing the motivation of the non-public economy to participate in mixed-ownership mergers and restructuring of state-owned enterprises. Fully respect the operational autonomy of enterprises, oppose all forms of forced transactions, and maximize the stimulation of the vitality and creativity of the non-public economy.

8. Correctly apply company capital legal rules, eliminating improper restrictions on capital contribution acts. Accurately grasp the legislative intent of the company capital system in the amended Company Law, correctly understand the role and function of company capital, and support normal and reasonable capital utilization acts of enterprises. Prudently handle shareholder capital contribution issues in accordance with the spirit of relaxing capital structure in the newly amended Company Law. Forms such as employee stock ownership associations and enterprise trade unions holding investment rights and interests on behalf of others are special forms in the capital structure of some enterprises currently. When enterprise mergers and restructuring involve changes in investment rights and interests, people's courts must lawfully coordinate the interest relationship between nominal shareholders and actual investors. Unless laws and regulations clearly provide otherwise, pay attention to facilitating enterprise establishment and development, fully respect investors' agreements and choices in aspects such as setting the amount of enterprise capital and the performance period of capital contribution obligations, ensuring investors smoothly build a restructuring platform.

9. Promote the diversification of financing methods, effectively solving the capital bottleneck of enterprise mergers and restructuring. For eligible enterprises issuing preferred shares or privately placing convertible bonds as payment methods for mergers and restructuring, lawfully confirm their validity. Prudently handle issues regarding the issuance of derivatives such as directional warrants as payment methods. Actively support the reform of the share pricing mechanism in mergers and restructuring of listed companies, and lawfully protect the negotiated pricing of shares in mergers and restructuring of non-listed companies. Lawfully urge enterprises, especially listed companies, to standardize the performance of information disclosure obligations, enhance market entity investment confidence, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of small and medium investors. At the same time, actively cooperate with financial regulatory authorities in performing their duties according to law.

III. Strengthen Protection of State-Owned Assets, Lawfully Ensure the Stability and Security of Enterprise Assets

10. Lawfully and correctly adjudicate cases of mergers and restructuring of state-owned enterprises, achieving the preservation and appreciation of state-owned assets. Correctly understand the relationship between the deepening reform of state-owned enterprises and enterprise mergers and restructuring, effectively ensure that qualified state-owned enterprises are restructured into state-owned capital investment companies, and continuously enhance the control and influence of the state-owned economy. Support enterprise development models that are conducive to expanding enterprise scale and strengthening strength within the existing legal framework. Pay attention to preventing enterprises from encroaching on or dividing state-owned assets through forms such as management buyouts and consolidated statements. Strictly follow evaluation and auction legal norms, promote the specialization and standardized development of intermediary service institutions by clarifying and implementing legal responsibilities, enhance service capabilities in key fields and weak links, and prevent and avoid the loss of state-owned assets during enterprise mergers and restructuring.

11. Lawfully regulate related-party transactions, strictly prohibit improper transfer of benefits. Strictly prevent the embezzlement of state-owned assets through related-party transactions. Properly handle related-party transaction acts in enterprise mergers and restructuring in accordance with the Company Law and other laws and regulations. Transactions between company shareholders, directors, senior management, and the company that comply with the procedural rules for related-party transactions provided by laws and regulations and do not harm the company's interests shall be deemed valid. For acts where major shareholders, actual controllers, or internal company personnel such as directors inject bad assets into the company using their special position during mergers and restructuring, or engage in unfair transactions with the company harming the company's interests, their legal liability shall be strictly pursued.

12. Severely crack down on illegal and criminal acts in enterprise mergers and restructuring. People's courts at all levels must fully leverage the function of criminal adjudication, adhere to the policy of strict punishment according to law, and severely crack down on criminal acts such as corruption, bribery, embezzlement of public funds, abuse of power, and illegal business operations in mergers and restructuring of state-owned enterprises. Lawfully and severely punish criminal acts such as embezzlement and misappropriation of enterprise funds in mergers and restructuring of non-state-owned enterprises, safeguard enterprise asset security, and simultaneously strive to recover economic losses of relevant subjects.

IV. Maintain Financial Security, Effectively Prevent and Control Regional and Systemic Financial Risks That May Arise from Various Disputes

13. Lawfully protect financial creditor rights, effectively prevent debt evasion through improper merger and restructuring means. For cases involving company mergers and divisions related to mergers and restructuring, clarify the liability relationship between different enterprises before and after the merger or division, the method of liability assumption, and the statute of limitations, to avoid financial creditor rights falling through due to mergers and restructuring. Lawfully and promptly adjudicate and enforce financial loan cases involving enterprises undergoing mergers and restructuring, reduce the risk of merger loans for commercial banks and other financial institutions, and ensure the sustainable conduct of merger loan financing methods in mergers and restructuring. Guide parties to fully utilize the procedures for realizing security interests under the Civil Procedure Law, reduce the cost of litigation for creditors to assert rights, and promote the swift and convenient realization of security interests.

14. Strengthen the adjudication of private financial cases, effectively mitigate financial risks. Properly adjudicate private financing disputes arising from mergers and restructuring, lawfully protect legal loan interest, resolutely curb the tendency of private usury and speculation under the guise of mergers and restructuring, and effectively reduce enterprise financing costs. Lawfully support and regulate the financial innovation behaviors of financial institutions in the field of enterprise mergers and restructuring, and lawfully and prudently determine the legal validity of financial innovation products. During trial and enforcement work, pay attention to discovering and preventing regional and systemic risks that may be triggered by litigation disputes, and effectively avoid the mutual transmission of financial risks between the financial field and the real economy sector. Severely crack down on and sanction financial crimes such as illegally absorbing or disguised absorption of public deposits, fund-raising fraud, etc., creating a good financing environment for enterprise mergers and restructuring.

V. Improve Market Exit Mechanisms, Promote the Optimal Integration of Enterprise Resources

15. Lawfully adjudicate enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases, smooth enterprise exit channels. Fully leverage the legal functions of enterprise liquidation procedures and bankruptcy procedures in eliminating outdated enterprises or production capacity, lawfully accept enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases, and urge market entities to exit in an orderly manner. After a people's court renders a judgment to dissolve an enterprise, it shall inform relevant persons to organize enterprise liquidation in a timely manner according to law. After the dissolution of an enterprise, if creditors or shareholders apply to the people's court for compulsory liquidation, the people's court shall review and lawfully accept it. If bankruptcy liquidation conditions are found during the liquidation of a company, it shall be promptly transferred to bankruptcy liquidation. If a party claims in accordance with the law that relevant persons assume corresponding liquidation responsibilities, the people's court shall support it.

16. Effectively leverage the special functions of bankruptcy reorganization procedures, promoting the circulation and utilization of enterprise resources. Actively support bankruptcy reorganization for enterprises that meet industrial policy adjustment targets and have hope and possibility for reorganization. Through lawful and efficient bankruptcy reorganization procedures, help enterprises compress and merge overcapacity, optimize the allocation of production factors such as capital, technology, and talent. Pay attention to combining the enterprise's own characteristics, promptly appoint a reorganization administrator, and ensure the enterprise's business process reengineering and technological upgrade and renovation. In the formulation and approval of enterprise reorganization plans, focus on establishing and improving a long-term mechanism to prevent and resolve overcapacity, prevent using bankruptcy reorganization to evade debts and improperly consume social resources, and avoid empty rotations of reorganization procedures.

17. Follow the adjudication rules of enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases, improve the trial work mechanism. Adjudicating enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases is not only a process of fact-finding and law application but also a systematic project requiring active coordination from multiple parties and overall advancement. People's courts with conditions may establish trial divisions or collegial panels for enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases, specialized in adjudicating enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases in mergers and restructuring. Attach high importance to the cultivation and use of judges for enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases, actively explore scientific and reasonable performance evaluation mechanisms for enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases based on actual conditions, and fully mobilize the enthusiasm of trial personnel in lawfully adjudicating enterprise liquidation and bankruptcy cases.

18. Carefully summarize trial experience in bankruptcy cases, gradually improve supporting systems for enterprise bankruptcy. If administrative licensing is involved in the bankruptcy reorganization of listed companies, do a good job in connecting judicial procedures and administrative licensing procedures in accordance with the spirit of the Administrative Licensing Law and the Supreme People's Court's "Summary of Minutes of the Symposium on Adjudicating Bankruptcy Reorganization Cases of Listed Companies." Coordinate the relationship between enterprise bankruptcy legal procedures and preservation enforcement measures taken by ordinary enforcement procedures against debtor enterprise property, maintaining the stability and integrity of debtor enterprise property. Actively coordinate to resolve issues of enterprise tax claims in bankruptcy procedures. Based on active communication with tax authorities, lawfully reduce or exempt corresponding taxes according to actual circumstances. Adapt to the trend of economic globalization, accelerate the improvement of judicial systems for cross-border liquidation and reorganization of enterprises.

VI. Fully Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of Employees, Spare No Effort to Maintain Social Harmony and Stability

19. Lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of workers, effectively ensure people's livelihood. Realizing that the fruits of reform and development benefit all people more and more fairly is the starting point and goal of all our undertakings. Although enterprise employees are not parties to the merger and restructuring agreement, they are stakeholders. During trial and enforcement, people's courts must promptly discover and listen to the interest demands of employees of enterprises undergoing mergers and restructuring, lawfully protect the legitimate rights and interests of enterprise employees, guide relevant enterprises to actively assume social responsibilities, and effectively prevent merger and restructuring acts from infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of enterprise employees.

20. Establish a reporting system for major and important cases, formulate necessary risk disposal plans. For series of lawsuits filed by numerous creditors concentrated against the same debtor enterprise, enterprise bankruptcy liquidation cases, group cases, and other cases that may have factors affecting social harmony and stability, people's courts must promptly activate the major case working mechanism. Particularly significant cases must be promptly reported to the local party committee and the superior people's court. The higher people's court must promptly guide the lower people's court in its work, make necessary predictions and plans for cases with prominent contradictions and high social attention, and enhance the foresight and targeting of judicial disposal.

21. Strengthen judicial news publicity, create a good social public opinion environment. Attach high importance to public opinion guidance and online publicity work, thoroughly investigate sensitive and hot issues involved in the adjudication of enterprise merger and restructuring cases, and make careful arrangements. Further promote judicial transparency, effectively promote positive interaction between judicial adjudication work and the external public opinion environment, and strive to create a social public opinion environment conducive to the smooth development of judicial work on enterprise mergers and restructuring.

Currently, China's economic system reform is advancing in depth. People's courts at all levels must further deeply study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's series of important speeches, firmly adhere to judicial service for the people and judicial fairness, persist in facing difficulties, dare to assume responsibility, and make new and greater contributions to optimizing the judicial environment for enterprise mergers and restructuring, ensuring sustained and healthy economic and social development, and advancing the construction of a rule-of-law China and a beautiful China.

June 3, 2014
